# Remote Operator Bash Command Queue

## PURPOSE

This file is the canonical append-only queue of Bash commands that agents request the prepared GitHub Actions Remote Operator to execute on the configured server.

## AGENT RULES

1. Every new Bash command MUST be appended to the END of this file.
2. Never overwrite, reorder, or delete existing commands.
3. Every command MUST have a unique immutable COMMAND_ID.
4. New commands MUST start with `STATUS: PENDING`.
5. Agents MUST NOT execute the command themselves when the intention is to use Remote Operator.
6. Do not manually change a command from PENDING to DONE. Only the executor may record execution state and result.
7. A command already marked CLAIMED, RUNNING, DONE, FAILED, or TIMEOUT must never be executed again automatically under the same COMMAND_ID.
8. Parallel agents may append different commands. They must not modify another agent's active command.
9. Keep the exact Bash command/script in the `COMMAND:` block.
10. Never put passwords, private keys, tokens, cookies, or other secrets into this file.
11. Commands are an audit trail and must remain in this file after completion.

## COMMAND FORMAT

Append a new block to the END of this file:

---
COMMAND_ID: cmd-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-unique
STATUS: PENDING
AGENT: <agent-id>
CREATED_AT: <UTC timestamp>
TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 30
MODE: sync

COMMAND:
<exact Bash command or multiline Bash script>
---

## EXECUTION LIFECYCLE

PENDING -> CLAIMED -> RUNNING -> DONE

Failure paths:

RUNNING -> FAILED
RUNNING -> TIMEOUT

The executor must claim a specific COMMAND_ID before starting it. Claiming must be concurrency-safe so two parallel workers cannot execute the same pending command.

## RESULT RECORD

After execution, the executor must preserve the original command and append/update execution metadata associated with the same COMMAND_ID:

STATUS: DONE | FAILED | TIMEOUT
ATTEMPT_ID: <unique attempt id>
STARTED_AT: <UTC timestamp>
FINISHED_AT: <UTC timestamp>
EXIT_CODE: <integer>
EXECUTOR: <worker/agent id>

The full stdout/stderr and structured result should be stored in the corresponding Actions artifact/result record rather than embedded without limit in this queue file.

## PARALLEL EXECUTION

Different COMMAND_ID values may run concurrently. A worker must claim only one unclaimed command at a time according to its configured concurrency. The COMMAND_ID is the idempotency key.

## IMPORTANT

This file is the single human/agent-facing command queue. Do not use `.github/remote-operator/COMMAND.txt` for new requests. New requests belong at the END of `COMMANDS.txt`.
---
COMMAND_ID: cmd-20260904-194301-production-parallel-1
STATUS: PENDING
AGENT: production-final
TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 1
MODE: sync
COMMAND:
printf 'PROD_PAR_1_START=%s\\n' "$(date +%s)"
sleep 8
printf 'PROD_PAR_1_END=%s\\n' "$(date +%s)"

COMMAND_ID: cmd-20260905-135000-server-health
STATUS: PENDING
AGENT: chatgpt-server-check
TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 2
MODE: sync
COMMAND:
set -e; echo SERVER_HEALTH_START; echo HOST=$(hostname); echo USER=$(id -un); echo UID=$(id -u); echo PWD=$(pwd); echo KERNEL=$(uname -sr); echo ARCH=$(uname -m); echo UPTIME=$(uptime -p); echo DISK=$(df -h /opt/madworld | awk 'NR==2{print $5 "," $4 " free"}'); echo MEMORY=$(free -h | awk '/Mem:/{print $7 " available"}'); echo OPERATOR=$(systemctl is-active madworld-remote-operator.service); echo OPERATOR_ENABLED=$(systemctl is-enabled madworld-remote-operator.service); echo SYNC_TIMER=$(systemctl is-active madworld-remote-operator-sync.timer); echo SYNC_ENABLED=$(systemctl is-enabled madworld-remote-operator-sync.timer); echo FAILED_UNITS=$(systemctl --failed --no-legend | wc -l); echo SERVER_HEALTH_OK

STATUS: PENDING
AGENT: chatgpt-server-status
TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 2
MODE: sync
COMMAND:
set -e; echo SERVER_STATUS_START; echo HOST=$(hostname); echo USER=$(id -un); echo UID=$(id -u); echo PWD=$(pwd); echo KERNEL=$(uname -sr); echo ARCH=$(uname -m); echo UPTIME=$(uptime -p); echo LOAD=$(cut -d' ' -f1-3 /proc/loadavg); echo DISK=$(df -h /opt/madworld | awk 'NR==2{print $5 "," $4 " free"}'); echo MEMORY=$(free -h | awk '/Mem:/{print $3 "/" $2 "," $7 " available"}'); echo OPERATOR=$(systemctl is-active madworld-remote-operator.service); echo SYNC_TIMER=$(systemctl is-active madworld-remote-operator-sync.timer); echo FAILED_UNITS=$(systemctl --failed --no-legend | wc -l); echo GIT_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo GIT_MAIN=$(git rev-parse origin/main 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); echo SERVER_STATUS_OK

COMMAND_ID: cmd-20260904-220600-home-tree
STATUS: PENDING
AGENT: chatgpt-home-tree
TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 2

COMMAND:
set -e; cd /home/ubuntu; echo HOME=/home/ubuntu; echo ===TREE===; if command -v tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then tree -a -L 3 -I '.cache|.local/share/Trash'; else find . -maxdepth 3 -print | sort; fi
---
COMMAND_ID: cmd-20260904-220900-operator-delivery-diagnostic
STATUS: PENDING
AGENT: chatgpt-operator-diagnostic
TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 3
MODE: sync
COMMAND:
set -u; echo DIAGNOSTIC_START; echo HOST=$(hostname); echo NOW=$(date -u +%FT%TZ); echo HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); echo ORIGIN_MAIN=$(git rev-parse origin/main 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); echo QUEUE_HOME_TREE=$(grep -A8 'COMMAND_ID: cmd-20260904-220600-home-tree' .github/remote-operator/COMMANDS.txt 2>/dev/null || true); echo STATE_HOME_TREE_BEGIN; cat .github/remote-operator/state/cmd-20260904-220600-home-tree.json 2>/dev/null || echo STATE=ABSENT; echo STATE_HOME_TREE_END; echo RESULT_HOME_TREE_BEGIN; cat .github/remote-operator/results/cmd-20260904-220600-home-tree/result.md 2>/dev/null || echo RESULT=ABSENT; echo RESULT_HOME_TREE_END; echo OPERATOR_ACTIVE=$(systemctl is-active madworld-remote-operator.service 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); echo OPERATOR_ENABLED=$(systemctl is-enabled madworld-remote-operator.service 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); echo SYNC_TIMER_ACTIVE=$(systemctl is-active madworld-remote-operator-sync.timer 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); echo SYNC_TIMER_ENABLED=$(systemctl is-enabled madworld-remote-operator-sync.timer 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); echo SYNC_LAST=$(systemctl show -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p ExecMainStatus madworld-remote-operator-sync.service 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' '); echo SYNC_TIMER_NEXT=$(systemctl list-timers --all --no-legend madworld-remote-operator-sync.timer 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true); echo OPERATOR_MAINPID=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value madworld-remote-operator.service 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); echo EXECUTOR_LOCK=$(flock -n 9 && echo FREE || echo BUSY) 9>.github/remote-operator/state/executor.lock; echo SYNC_LOCK=$(flock -n 9 && echo FREE || echo BUSY) 9>.github/remote-operator/state/result-sync.lock; echo RESULT_BRANCH=$(git ls-remote --heads origin remote-operator-results 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' || true); echo FAILED_UNITS=$(systemctl --failed --no-legend 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo DIAGNOSTIC_END
---
COMMAND_ID: cmd-20260905-135500-disk-space
STATUS: PENDING
AGENT: chatgpt-disk-space
TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 2
MODE: sync
COMMAND:
set -e; echo DISK_SPACE_START; echo ROOT=$(df -h / | awk 'NR==2{print $4 " free (" $5 " used)"}'); echo MADWORLD=$(df -h /opt/madworld | awk 'NR==2{print $4 " free (" $5 " used)"}'); echo HOME=$(df -h /home/ubuntu | awk 'NR==2{print $4 " free (" $5 " used)"}'); echo DISK_SPACE_OK
---
COMMAND_ID: cmd-20260905-140000-server-status-tree
STATUS: PENDING
AGENT: chatgpt-server-status-tree
TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 3
MODE: sync
COMMAND:
set -euo pipefail
printf '%s\n' 'SERVER_STATUS_TREE_START'
printf 'HOST=%s\n' "$(hostname)"
printf 'USER=%s\n' "$(id -un)"
printf 'ARCH=%s\n' "$(uname -m)"
printf 'KERNEL=%s\n' "$(uname -sr)"
printf 'UPTIME=%s\n' "$(uptime -p)"
printf 'LOAD=%s\n' "$(cut -d' ' -f1-3 /proc/loadavg)"
printf 'MEMORY=%s\n' "$(free -h | awk '/Mem:/{print $3 "/" $2 " used, " $7 " available}')"
printf 'DISK_ROOT=%s\n' "$(df -h / | awk 'NR==2{print $3 "/" $2 " used, " $4 " free (" $5 ")}')"
printf 'DISK_MADWORLD=%s\n' "$(df -h /opt/madworld | awk 'NR==2{print $3 "/" $2 " used, " $4 " free (" $5 ")}')"
printf 'OPERATOR=%s\n' "$(systemctl is-active madworld-remote-operator.service)"
printf 'OPERATOR_ENABLED=%s\n' "$(systemctl is-enabled madworld-remote-operator.service)"
printf 'SYNC_TIMER=%s\n' "$(systemctl is-active madworld-remote-operator-sync.timer)"
printf 'SYNC_TIMER_ENABLED=%s\n' "$(systemctl is-enabled madworld-remote-operator-sync.timer)"
printf 'FAILED_UNITS=%s\n' "$(systemctl --failed --no-legend | wc -l)"
printf '%s\n' '===FILESYSTEM_TOP=== '
find / -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -xdev -printf '%p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort
printf '%s\n' '===MADWORLD_TREE=== '
if command -v tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then tree -a -L 3 -I '.git|state|results' /opt/madworld 2>/dev/null; else find /opt/madworld -maxdepth 3 -print | sort; fi
printf '%s\n' '===HOME_TREE=== '
if command -v tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then tree -a -L 2 -I '.cache|.local/share/Trash|.gradle|.android|.hermes/hermes-venv' /home/ubuntu 2>/dev/null; else find /home/ubuntu -maxdepth 2 -print | sort; fi
printf '%s\n' 'SERVER_STATUS_TREE_OK'
---
COMMAND_ID: cmd-20260905-140500-server-runtime-final
STATUS: PENDING
AGENT: chatgpt-final-runtime
CREATED_AT: 2026-09-05T14:05:00Z
TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 5
MODE: sync
COMMAND:
set -euo pipefail
printf '%s\n' 'RUNTIME_FINAL_START'
printf 'HOST=%s\n' "$(hostname)"
printf 'NOW=%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
printf 'GIT_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git -C /opt/madworld rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
printf 'GIT_MAIN=%s\n' "$(git -C /opt/madworld rev-parse origin/main 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
printf 'GIT_STATUS=%s\n' "$(git -C /opt/madworld status --short --branch 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
printf 'HEALTH='; curl -fsS --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1/health 2>&1 || true; printf '\n'
printf 'READINESS='; curl -fsS --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1/health/ready 2>&1 || true; printf '\n'
printf '%s\n' 'CONTAINERS='
docker compose -f /opt/madworld/docker-compose.yml ps 2>&1 || docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}'
printf '%s\n' 'FAILED_UNITS='; systemctl --failed --no-legend 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' 'OPERATOR='; systemctl is-active madworld-remote-operator.service 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' 'SYNC_TIMER='; systemctl is-active madworld-remote-operator-sync.timer 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' 'RUNTIME_FINAL_END'
---
COMMAND_ID: cmd-20260905-141500-production-proxy-check
STATUS: PENDING
AGENT: chatgpt-production-proxy
CREATED_AT: 2026-09-05T14:15:00Z
TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 5
MODE: sync
COMMAND:
set -u
printf '%s\n' 'PRODUCTION_PROXY_CHECK_START'
printf 'HOST=%s\n' "$(hostname)"
printf 'NOW=%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
printf 'REPO_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git -C /opt/madworld rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
printf 'ORIGIN_MAIN=%s\n' "$(git -C /opt/madworld rev-parse origin/main 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
printf 'REPO_REMOTE=%s\n' "$(git -C /opt/madworld remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
printf 'BRANCH=%s\n' "$(git -C /opt/madworld branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
printf '%s\n' 'RECENT_COMMITS='
git -C /opt/madworld log -8 --oneline --decorate 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' 'GIT_STATUS='
git -C /opt/madworld status --short --branch 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' 'NGINX_CONFIG_TEST='
nginx -t 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' 'NGINX_SERVER_NAMES='
nginx -T 2>/dev/null | awk '/server_name[[:space:]]/{print}' | head -80 || true
printf '%s\n' 'NGINX_LISTEN='
nginx -T 2>/dev/null | awk '/listen[[:space:]]/{print}' | head -80 || true
printf '%s\n' 'HTTP_HEADERS='
curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1/health 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' 'HTTPS_HEADERS='
curl -k -sS -D - -o /dev/null --max-time 10 https://127.0.0.1/health 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' 'LOCAL_HTTP_HEALTH='
curl -sS -L -D - --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1/health 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' 'LOCAL_HTTP_READY='
curl -sS -L -D - --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1/health/ready 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' 'DOCKER_PS='
docker compose -f /opt/madworld/docker-compose.yml ps 2>&1 || docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}'
printf '%s\n' 'API_PORTS='
ss -lntp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':(80|443|8000|8090|5432|5433)\\b' || true
printf '%s\n' 'PRODUCTION_PROXY_CHECK_END'
---
